items.text: abhi tak nahi hua
phone uthao
ghar par nahi gaya
complaint toh kar di
samajh nahi aaya
kya karna hai
order kab milega

items.context: Aapko kis service mein problem aa rahi hai?
items.text: jaldi se batao

items.context: Kya main aapka complaint number le sakta hun?
items.text: zameen par problem hai

items.context: Aapko kis tarah ki madad chahiye?
items.text: upgrade karna hai
mera complaint pehle bhi register hua tha lekin solve nahi hua
maine kal call kiya tha par customer care ne fayda nahi kiya
ghar mein internet abhi bhi slow chal raha hai aap kuch karo
mujhe abhi bhi pata nahi chal raha ki mera issue kab solve hoga
mere paise account se cut gaye par service abhi tak active nahi hai
problem ko escalate kar do mujhe aur intezar nahi karna hai
main Mumbai se bol raha hun aur mera connection bilkul down hai

items.context: Kya aapko previous complaint ka solution mil gaya?
items.text: haan ji abhi tak problem solve nahi hua hamein bahut takleef ho rahi hai

items.context: Aapki complaint kis date ko register hui thi?
items.text: main chahata hun ki aap mere complaint ko turant escalate karein

items.context: Kitni baar aapne complaint register karwai?
items.text: maine do hafton se baar baar call kiya hai par complain solve nahi ho rahi

items.context: Kya main aapke issue ko escalate kar sakta hun?
items.text: kya aap mujhe senior manager se baat karva sakte hain

items.context: Aapko kis wajah se takleef ho rahi hai?
items.text: ab delay zyada ho gaya hai ab aur intezar karna mushkil hai
maine pehle bhi apni problem batai thi lekin abhi tak koi solution nahi mila hai mujhe bahut pareshaani ho rahi hai
agar meri problem ko jaldi solve nahi kiya gaya to main customer service se complaint escalate karunga aur senior officer se baat karunga
meri connection abhi tak thik se kaam nahi kar rahi hai phone aur internet dono mein problem hai main Mumbai mein rahata hun

items.context: Kya aapne apni complaint ke baare mein pahle bhi humse baat ki hai?
items.text: pehle bhi maine complaint register karwai thi par us par koi karwai nahi hui mujhe lagta hai ki mera issue ignore kiya ja raha hai

items.context: Aapne ab tak kitni baar customer care ko contact kiya hai?
items.text: maine kai baar call kiya hai aur baar baar promise kiya jata hai par abhi tak service sahi nahi hui hai mujhe kuch help chahiye

items.context: Aapki samasya kab se chal rahi hai aur aapko kya dikkat ho rahi hai?
items.text: ye problem 10 din se chal rahi hai aur main paise bhi de raha hun jabki service bilkul sahi nahi hai mujhe escalate karna padega

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: escalate_complaint - is unhappy that an earlier complaint was not solved and wants escalation
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
